changeSet.author: golfcomp
changeSet.comment: Update chk_scores_value constraint from 18-150 to 0-72 to match updated score range
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE scores DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_scores_value; ALTER TABLE scores ADD CONSTRAINT chk_scores_value CHECK (score_value >= 0 AND score_value <= 72);

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE scores DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_scores_value; ALTER TABLE scores ADD CONSTRAINT chk_scores_value CHECK (score_value >= 18 AND score_value <= 150);
